column3: Close to the Hebrew; תּוּשִׁיָּה (“sound wisdom”) is rendered “sound wisdom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his godly ones” is rendered “His saints.”
Close to the Hebrew; מֵאִשָּׁה זָרָה (“the strange woman”) is rendered “the immoral woman,” and “the foreign woman” “the seductress.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְאֶל־ רְפָאִים (“to the shades, Rephaim”) is rendered “to the dead.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the way of the good” is rendered “the way of goodness,” and “the paths of the righteous” “the paths of righteousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the land” is rendered “the earth.”
